urls.rationale: 120C-100 Definitions: foundational definitions for the lobbying chapter.
120C-101 Rules and forms: rulemaking authority and prescribed forms for lobbying registration/reporting.
120C-102 Request for advice: advisory-opinion mechanism under the lobbying chapter.
120C-103 Lobbying education program: chapter-internal education/resource provision.
120C-104 Chapter applies to candidates for certain offices: scope extension of the lobbying chapter.

notes: Excluded the two 'Reserved for future codification purposes' range placeholders (120C-1through120c-99, 120C-105through120c-199) -- no statute body.
